concepts.def: Less than 250mm rainfall/year; large diurnal temperature range; sandy or rocky surfaces; e.g. Sahara, Atacama, Sonoran.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Coastal Environments — a core area of GCSE Geography.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Coastal Environments brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Coastal Environments.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
